Garlic (Allium sativum) 
 Cumin (Cuminum cyminum)

fullContent:
Lashunadi Vati 
 Reference: Vaidyajivana, Kshaya roga Chikitsa 
 Introduction 
 Lashunadi Vati is an herbal formulation in a tablet form. It is used in treating diarrhea, dyspepsia, and intestinal disorders. Lashun means garlic and that is the prime ingredient of this formulation. It equalizes Kapha and Vata and also enhances pitta. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Garlic (Allium sativum) 
 Cumin (Cuminum cyminum) 
 Saindhav Lavana (Rock salt) 
 Shudh Gandhaka (Purified Sulphur) 
 Saunth/ dry ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Asafetida 
 Sufficient amount of lemon juice 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and grind all the ingredients to a fine powder and mix in sufficient amount of lemon juice and mix it till it forms the consistency of a paste and make tablets from it and let these tablets be in the dryer till they harden. Now, store them in a clean and dry place in an air tight jar. 
 Dosage 
 1 to 2 tablets twice daily with water or as prescribed by your doctor. 
 Indications 
 
 Gastroenteritis 
 Diarrhea 
 Low digestive power 
 Dyspepsia 
 Intestinal ailments 
 Stomach ailments 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage is discouraged as it might cause burning sensation in stomach. 
 As it contains salt, patients with hypertension should take it under strict medical advice. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
